_comment: Opt-in typecheck for tests/e2e — NOT consumed by `pnpm -r typecheck` (which iterates the workspace packages). Trigger explicitly via `pnpm run typecheck:e2e`. Extends the root base so module resolution / strictness / NodeNext line up with the rest of the repo. `baseUrl` + `paths` map the workspace package names to their source `.ts` files (instead of relying on workspace symlinks, which don't exist at `tests/e2e/node_modules`) — same pattern as tests/integration/tsconfig.json but with two extra entries: shared is consumed via bridge's tree-shake paths, and @playwright/test (root devDependency) is loaded via module resolution from node_modules. We deliberately do NOT include the `.tmp/` subtree (the per-run fixture) — it's runtime-only and not part of the source graph.
